name: Projects
summary: Hand a feature, migration, or app to a coordinator agent that plans the work, farms it out to parallel subagents in the cloud, and brings back results to review. Keeps context for months and runs on after you close the laptop. Beta for all users.

name: Agents API
summary: Build cloud agents on the same harness that runs Codex with one API call. It handles sessions, context compaction, sub-agents, and crash recovery, and you pick the sandbox. Public beta for all developers, no fee beyond tokens and tools.

name: GPT-Live-1
summary: Build voice agents that listen and talk at the same time, handle interruptions, and run over phone lines. 12 voices, transcripts included, $0.05 per minute billed by the second, plus whatever backend model you plug in.

name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
summary: Run a 1M-context multimodal model for pennies — $0.30 per million input tokens at peak, half that off-peak. It beats the older V4 Pro on speed and cost, and the 485B weights are up on Hugging Face.

name: ML Intern
summary: Describe an ML idea in plain English and it finds the models and datasets, estimates the compute bill, trains the model, uploads it to the Hub, and builds a demo. Free in HuggingChat, plus an open-source CLI. One demo run cost under 50 cents.

name: Suno v6
summary: Edit specific sections of a generated song by prompt, use images or video as creative references, and pull instruments out of samples. v6-mini is free for everyone. v6 and v6-wild need a paid plan.

name: Mercury 2.5
summary: Get 1,100 tokens per second from a diffusion LLM with 260K context, tool calls, and JSON output. Launch pricing is $0.04 per million input and $0.15 output, with 100M free tokens, via Inception's API or OpenRouter.

name: ChatGPT Images 2.5
summary: Generate and edit images with much better likeness for people and pets, up to 50% faster. Rolling out to every ChatGPT tier plus Codex, with a @Sketch tool for drawing references and two new API models, Flare and Sunburst.
